facts.fact: Mapa III of Law 69/X/2025 appropriates CVE 174,200,533 to the Ministério da Economia Digital for 2026, with investment at zero.
The Ministério da Economia Digital's appropriation falls from CVE 369,781,930 in 2025 to CVE 174,200,533 in 2026 (and from CVE 1,390,965,632 in 2024).

Law 69/X/2025 earmarks the operators' communications contribution and the radio-spectrum fee to the Fundo de Serviço Universal e Desenvolvimento da Sociedade de Informação (FUSI), with CVE 122,073,633 appropriated for 2026, identical to 2024 and 2025; the document does not give the law that set up the fund or any amount collected or paid out.
